<a id="page-actions"></a>
# Actions

An action is a JSON object `{"type": "<type>", ...fields}`, run in order in a reaction's chain. Text fields are
expressions (`"${count}"`, `"${= a + 1}"`). A field holding nested actions (`then`, `else`, `onSuccess`...) is a
list of actions. A key not listed for the type is dropped by decoding and reported by validation
(`unknown_action_key`).

## Fields every action has

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | False skips the action. |
| `nonBlocking` | bool | `false` |  | The chain doesn't wait for it, and its failure doesn't stop the chain. |
| `when` | Object | unset |  | Runs only when it holds. |

Fields holding nested action chains (a list of actions): `then`, `else`, `actions`, `onSuccess`, `onError`, `cancelActions`.

<a id="action-navigate"></a>
## `navigate`: Navigate

Goes to another screen. JSON: `{"type": "navigate", "mode": "push", "to": "canvas-b", "params": {"id": "${item.id}"}}`. The destination reads `params` as `${route.<name>}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | [NavigationMode](values.md#enum-NavigationMode) | `"push"` | `push`, `pop`, `replace`, `reset` |  |
| `to` | String | `""` |  | A screen (canvas) or layout id. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Values the destination reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `base` | String | `""` |  | `NavigationMode.reset`: a screen to put under the destination, so going back from it lands there. |
| `baseParams` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `transition` | [PageTransition](values.md#enum-PageTransition) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `none`, `fade`, `fadeUp`, `slideUp`, `slideLeft`, `scale` |  |
| `transitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](values.md#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | A custom transition; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-openModal"></a>
## `openModal`: Open modal

Shows a screen (canvas) as a modal: a dialog, a sheet, a popover. The `CloseModalAction` that closes it gives the chain that opened it its `${result}`. JSON: `{"type": "openModal", "to": "canvas-d", "presentation": "bottomSheet"}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | String | `""` |  | The screen (canvas) shown. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Values the modal reads as ${route.<name>}. |
| `presentation` | [ModalPresentation](values.md#enum-ModalPresentation) | `"dialog"` | `dialog`, `bottomSheet`, `adaptive`, `sideSheet`, `fullScreen`, `popover`, `banner` |  |
| `barrierDismissible` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `barrierColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | unset |  | Null: the default scrim. |
| `barrierBlur` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `showCloseButton` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `showDragHandle` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `alignment` | List<double> | `[0,0]` |  | A dialog's alignment, [x, y] (-1 to 1). |
| `anchor` | [ModalAnchor](values.md#enum-ModalAnchor) | `"none"` | `none`, `trigger`, `pointer`, `node` |  |
| `placement` | [PopoverPlacement](values.md#enum-PopoverPlacement) | `"belowStart"` |  |  |
| `anchorGap` | double | `4` |  |  |
| `anchorOffset` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `anchorReserve` | double | `0` |  | Room a popover keeps below its top: when its top plus this would pass the screen's bottom margin, it moves up to fit it (a menu keeps its place as it grows). 0: by its own height. |
| `anchorNode` | String | `""` |  | Anchor "node": the node the popover sits by (an id; may be an expression). |
| `anchorItem` | String | `""` |  | Anchor "node", for a node a list repeats: the item whose copy it sits by (its id or key, or its index). |
| `insets` | List<double> | `[0,0,0,0]` |  | Space kept around a dialog: left, top, right, bottom. |
| `sheetWidth` | double | unset |  |  |
| `sheetRadius` | double | unset |  | A bottom sheet's top corner radius; the sheet clips the screen to it (null: the default). |
| `sheetBelow` | String | `""` |  | Adaptive: a bottom sheet on breakpoints narrower than this one (a breakpoint id; empty: the second). |
| `maxHeightFactor` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `fullHeight` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `cover` | bool | `false` |  | A dialog that covers the screen: its screen fills it at the device size (its breakpoint follows the device). |
| `enterScale` | double | `1` |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](values.md#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | A custom transition: entrance, the screen behind, barrier, drag to dismiss. |

<a id="action-closeModal"></a>
## `closeModal`: Close modal

Closes the modal it runs in, giving the chain that opened it `result` (its text values are expressions) as `${result}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | Object | unset |  | What the opening chain reads as ${result}; text values are expressions. |

<a id="action-retryFailed"></a>
## `retryFailed`: Retry failed actions

In an actionError reaction: runs the failed action chain again.

_No fields._

<a id="action-setVariable"></a>
## `setVariable`: Set variable

Changes variable `variable` (of the screen, or the app): `write`. JSON: `{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "count", "op": "add", "value": "1"}`. A computed variable can't be set. A number can glide to its new value (`animateMs`, `curve`): the variable changes every frame (what's bound to it moves with it), and the chain goes on when it arrives.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable's name; a path into it sets that part. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |

<a id="action-callFunction"></a>
## `callFunction`: Call function

Calls a function the app registered by `name` with `params` (text values are expressions). Its result is the chain's `${result}`: what the app's code answered (a permission granted, a share completed), which the next actions branch on. A function the app didn't register fails the chain, unless the action is `optional`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | String | `""` |  | The function the app registered. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its arguments; text values are expressions. |
| `optional` | bool | `false` |  | A function the app didn't register is skipped (${result} is null) instead of failing the chain. |

<a id="action-if"></a>
## `if`: If

Runs `then` when `condition` holds, else `orElse`. JSON: `{"type": "if", "condition": {...}, "then": [...], "else": [...]}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | Object | unset |  | A predicate; null never holds. |
| `then` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it holds. |
| `else` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it doesn't. |

<a id="action-forEach"></a>
## `forEach`: For each

Runs `actions` once per item of list `items` (a path or expression). Every action of a turn reads the item and its index as `${loop.item}` and `${loop.index}`; `${result.item}` and `${result.index}` hold them too, until an action of the turn gives a result of its own.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | String | `""` |  | A list (a path or expression). |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}). |

<a id="action-scrollTo"></a>
## `scrollTo`: Scroll to

Scrolls node `node` into view: `alignment` 0 puts it at the start of the view, 1 at the end; `offset` moves it further. `axis` limits it to the scroll views along one axis (a map in a sideways window centers a point without scrolling the page under it); null scrolls every one around it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | The node to reveal: its id, or an expression giving one (`"cmp-col-${cmpCol + 1}"`). A node that is not on screen when the action runs is reported as an action error, not skipped silently. |
| `item` | String | `""` |  | For a repeated node: the key (or index) of the list item whose copy to reveal. |
| `durationMs` | int | `400` |  |  |
| `curve` | String | `"easeInOut"` |  | A Curves name. |
| `alignment` | double | `0` |  | 0: at the start of the view, 1: at the end. |
| `offset` | double | `0` |  |  |
| `axis` | [ScrollAxis](values.md#enum-ScrollAxis) | unset | `horizontal`, `vertical` | Only the scroll views along this axis; null: every one. |

<a id="action-animate"></a>
## `animate`: Animate

Drives an animation (Flutter's `AnimationController` methods): node `node`'s `animation` (`NodeAnimation`), or the number variable `variable` (an unbounded controller the screen keeps for it). JSON: `{"type": "animate", "node": "card", "animation": "pop", "command": "forward", "from": "0"}`, `{"type": "animate", "variable": "shownTotal", "command": "animateTo", "target": "${total}", "duration": "800", "curve": "easeOutCubic"}`. The chain waits for it to end (`TickerFuture`) unless it's `nonBlocking`; a repeat ends when its count does.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A node id or key; empty: the reacting node. |
| `animation` | String | `""` |  | The animation's id on the node. |
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | Instead of a node: a number variable. |
| `command` | [AnimateCommand](values.md#enum-AnimateCommand) | `"forward"` | `forward`, `reverse`, `toggle`, `repeat`, `stop`, `reset`, `animateTo`, `animateBack`, `set` |  |
| `from` | String | `""` |  | Where forward/reverse start (an expression). |
| `target` | String | `""` |  | animateTo, animateBack, set (an expression). |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | Milliseconds (an expression); empty: the animation's. |
| `curve` | [AnimationCurve](values.md#enum-AnimationCurve) | unset |  | Null: the animation's (linear for a variable). |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) | unset |  | `animateWith(SpringSimulation)` toward `target` instead of a duration. |

<a id="action-runScript"></a>
## `runScript`: Run script

Runs script `script` (a layout's `scripts`, by id) with `arguments` (by parameter name; expressions: one `${...}` passes its value as is, other text passes as JSON when it is JSON, else as text). Its result is the chain's `${result}` (and goes in `resultVariable` when set). When it fails, `onError` runs with `${result}` `{error: {type, message, line, column}, logs}`; without `onError` a failure stops the chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | String | `""` |  | A script of the layout's scripts. |
| `arguments` | Object | unset |  | By parameter name (expressions). |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets the result. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it fails (${result.error}, ${result.logs}). |

<a id="action-callApi"></a>

Calls API `api` (the publish model's `services.apis`) with `params`, its inputs (expressions; an empty one takes the input's default). Then `onSuccess` runs after a 2xx response, `onError` after any other or a failed request, both reading the response as `${result}`. A failed request without `onError` stops the chain.

| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its inputs, by name (expressions). |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a 2xx response. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run after a failure. |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
## `loadCloudData`: Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

One variable has one live load: running the action again (or a `ReloadCloudDataAction`) replaces the earlier subscription. Unless `reactive` is false, the load runs again by itself when a value its query reads changes (`${auth.uid}`, `${search}`, a `limit` bound to a variable), but never for a change of its own variable.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `single` | bool | `true` |  | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `query` | Object | unset |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | [CloudDataScope](values.md#enum-CloudDataScope) | `"screen"` | `screen`, `app` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | String | `""` |  | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | [CloudLoadAggregate](values.md#enum-CloudLoadAggregate) | `"none"` | `none`, `count`, `sum`, `average` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | int | `0` | ≥ 0 | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | bool | `true` |  | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
## `reloadCloudData`: Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

<a id="action-cloudFiles"></a>
## `cloudFiles`: Cloud files

Uploads files the user picks to (or deletes them from) cloud storage folder `path`; `actions` run with each file (`${result.url}`...). With a `source`, it uploads that value instead of asking the user (a captured screenshot, a drawing).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudFilesOperation](values.md#enum-CloudFilesOperation) | `"upload"` | `upload`, `delete` |  |
| `path` | String | `""` |  | The storage folder. |
| `kind` | [CloudFileKind](values.md#enum-CloudFileKind) | `"image"` | `image`, `any` |  |
| `allowMultiple` | bool | `true` |  |  |
| `maxSizeMB` | double | `10` |  |  |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `access` | [CloudFileAccess](values.md#enum-CloudFileAccess) | `"public"` | `public`, `private` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | Uploads this instead of asking the user: a data: URL (${result.image} of a screenshot), or a list. |
| `fileName` | String | `""` |  | The name a source file is stored under. |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

<a id="action-cloudData"></a>
## `cloudData`: Cloud data

Creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection. Its result (the new id, the document, the documents, the number) is the chain's `${result}` and goes in `resultVariable`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [CloudDataOperation](values.md#enum-CloudDataOperation) | `"create"` | `create`, `update`, `delete`, `get`, `query`, `count`, `sum`, `average` |  |
| `collection` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `fields` | Object | unset |  | Field writes: [{"field", "value", "operation"}]. |
| `whereFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `orderByFilters` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `limit` | int | unset |  |  |
| `aggregateField` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `loadRelated` | List<String> | `[]` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  |  |

<a id="action-cloudBatch"></a>
## `cloudBatch`: Cloud batch

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

Up to `kMaxCloudBatchWrites` writes are all or none. More are committed in chunks of that size, each all or none; with `transaction`, more fail before anything is written. A batch with a read step (get, query, count, sum, average) runs its steps one by one, as before.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | Object | unset |  | Nested cloudData actions. |
| `transaction` | bool | `false` |  | All or none: more than 500 writes fail instead of committing in chunks. |
| `forEach` | String | `""` |  | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |

<a id="action-submitForm"></a>
## `submitForm`: Submit form

Validates a form's answers and stores them in the app's own variables (`service: local`). See `docs/submit_form.md`.

A remote destination is an explicit later action (`callApi` in `onSuccess`) to an endpoint the app defines; this action itself never calls a service.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | [FormService](values.md#enum-FormService) | `"local"` | `local` | Only `local` is offered: `FormService.unsupported` marks old data. |
| `payload` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. |
| `validationScript` | String | `""` |  | Await a script returning {valid, errors?, payload?}. |
| `validationArguments` | Object | unset |  | Named script argument expressions. |
| `responseVariable` | String | `""` |  | Optional mutable list variable receiving the validated payload. Persist the variable to keep submissions. |
| `prepend` | bool | `false` |  |  |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | An expression yielding a JSON object. An awaited validator may replace it with its normalized `payload`. |
| `onSuccess` | Object | unset |  |  |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  |  |

<a id="action-auth"></a>
## `auth`: Auth

Signs app users in, up and out, and manages their account. A failure's message goes in `errorVariable` (and stops the chain).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [AuthOperation](values.md#enum-AuthOperation) | `"signIn"` |  |  |
| `email` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `password` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `displayName` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `photoUrl` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `currentPassword` | String | `""` |  | Re-authenticates first (change password, delete account). |
| `errorVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets a failure's message. |

<a id="action-paywall"></a>
## `paywall`: Paywall

A paywall interaction: buy the selected (or `slot`'s) product, restore purchases, select a product, close the paywall, open a legal `url`, or open a server-resolved `placement`.

`PaywallOperation.openPaywall` shows the placement's screen as a navigation would: with `routeTransition` (a custom transition: a cover from the bottom, a reveal...) or `transition`, `transitionMs` and `reverseTransitionMs`; it plays in reverse when the paywall closes.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | [PaywallOperation](values.md#enum-PaywallOperation) | `"purchase"` | `purchase`, `restore`, `selectProduct`, `closePaywall`, `openLegalLink`, `openPaywall` |  |
| `placement` | String | unset |  | The server-resolved placement to open. |
| `offer` | String | unset |  | storeDefault, trial, or standard; expressions allowed. |
| `slot` | String | unset |  |  |
| `url` | String | unset |  | A legal link. |
| `transition` | [PageTransition](values.md#enum-PageTransition) | `"platform"` | `platform`, `none`, `fade`, `fadeUp`, `slideUp`, `slideLeft`, `scale` | openPaywall: how its screen opens. |
| `transitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `reverseTransitionMs` | int | unset |  |  |
| `routeTransition` | [RouteTransition](values.md#type-RouteTransition) | unset |  | openPaywall: a custom transition for its screen; replaces transition and its times. |

<a id="action-print"></a>
## `print`: Print

Requests the platform print dialog for a rendered node. The user chooses the destination and confirms; this action never silently submits a job.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A rendered node to print through a user-confirmed platform dialog. |

<a id="action-preloadImages"></a>
## `preloadImages`: Preload images

Loads images ahead of showing them (a story's pages before reading), so they draw at once: `urls` is an expression giving a list of URLs (or a comma-separated text). While it runs, `progressVariable` (a variable's name; empty for none) holds the share done (0–1). It waits for every image and gives `{loaded, failed, total}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | String | `""` |  | The image URLs: a list (an expression) or comma-separated text. |
| `progressVariable` | String | `""` |  | A variable to hold the share loaded (0-1) while it runs. |

<a id="action-speak"></a>
## `speak`: Speak

Reads `text` aloud, or `stop`s speaking. `rate` and `pitch` are numbers or expressions.

With `readAlong` the words are timed for a read-along highlight (`speech.wordIndex`): the text is said a phrase at a time, each word gets time by its syllables from the moment its phrase starts sounding, and the voice's word boundaries (when it reports them) snap the highlight to the real word and set the pace; without a voice the words are read along silently at that pace. It starts at `startWord` and the action waits until the text has been said (its result: `{completed: bool}`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `language` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `rate` | String | `"1"` |  | A number or expression. |
| `pitch` | String | `""` |  | A number or expression. |
| `stop` | bool | `false` |  | Stops speaking. |
| `readAlong` | bool | `false` |  | Times every word (speech.wordIndex) even when the voice reports no word boundaries, and reads along silently without a voice; the action waits until the text is said. |
| `startWord` | String | `""` |  | Read along: the word to start at (an index or expression), to carry on after a pause. |

<a id="action-playSound"></a>
## `playSound`: Play sound

Plays a synthesised `sound` (a voice name), now or `at` a time on the sound clock, or the sound file at `url`. Every field is an expression.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | String | `"wood"` |  | A synthesised voice name. |
| `operation` | String | `"play"` |  | play, start, stop, or stopAll. |
| `voiceId` | String | `""` |  | The independently owned sustained voice. |
| `frequency` | String | `"440"` |  | Sustained tone frequency in hertz. |
| `waveform` | String | `"sine"` |  | Sustained voice: sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, felt, reed or pluck. |
| `note` | String | `""` |  | A MIDI note number (60 = middle C) in place of frequency. |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | Milliseconds until a started voice releases itself; empty sustains. |
| `volume` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `pitch` | String | `"1"` |  |  |
| `at` | String | `""` |  | A time on the sound clock. |
| `url` | String | `""` |  | A sound file. |

<a id="action-captureScreenshot"></a>
## `captureScreenshot`: Capture screenshot

Captures what is on screen as a PNG image. `${result}` is `{"image": "data:image/png;base64,...", "width", "height"}` (in pixels): bind it to an image fill to show it, or upload it with a `cloudFiles` action whose `source` is `${result.image}`. JSON: `{"type": "captureScreenshot", "target": "app"}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | [CaptureTarget](values.md#enum-CaptureTarget) | `"layout"` | `layout`, `node`, `app` | The screen, one of its nodes, or the whole app (in the host's capture scope). |
| `node` | String | `""` |  | The node captured (target node). |
| `pixelRatio` | double | `0` |  | Pixels per logical pixel; 0: the device's. |

<a id="action-downloadFile"></a>
## `downloadFile`: Download file

Exports generated UTF-8 text (CSV, JSON, plain text...) as a file. The browser downloads it; native apps show the platform save picker. Cancellation returns `{saved: false}` as the action result.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fileName` | String | `"export.txt"` |  | Suggested filename, an expression. |
| `text` | String | `""` |  | Generated file contents as UTF-8 text. |
| `mimeType` | String | `"text/plain"` |  |  |

<a id="action-emitEvent"></a>
## `emitEvent`: Emit event

Fires app event `event` with `props` (text values are expressions) on the app's event bus: the project's automations listening for it run (a popup after the third order), and the host app hears it (`codelessly.events`). The same bus a host fires with `codelessly.emit(name, props)`. JSON: `{"type": "emitEvent", "event": "onboarding_done", "props": {"plan": "${plan}"}}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | String | `""` |  | The app event's name (an expression). |
| `props` | Object | unset |  | Its properties; text values are expressions. |
